messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High generation latency and 5xx spike on /v1/generate — region: us-west-2. Affected clusters: genpool-gw-3, genpool-gw-4. Thresholds: p95 > 2.5s, 5xx rate > 1%. Paging alice (oncall).
alice (oncall): on it. joining. assigning to ben for deep-dive. ping carla for comms.
ben (sre): grabbing logs and metrics now. early signal: GPU queue length jumped, KV cache churn on genpool-gw-3. seeing OOM-ish gc thrash on one pod.
ben (sre): running `kubectl top pod -n genprod gen-gw-3-7f8d` — memory at 98%, RPS steady but token emit slower. also seeing many `oom_killed` events in the last 3m.
alice (oncall): thanks. carla, can you draft a brief initial customer-facing status line? keep it short: what impacted, region, mitigation underway.
carla (ops): draft below — please quick edit:
```
Initial: We are investigating increased latency and error rates for text generation in US-West. Engineers are actively mitigating; no data loss. More updates within 30 minutes.
```
alice (oncall): good. eve, please prep a support blurb for customers who've opened tickets.
eve (support): on it. suggested short reply:
"We are aware of higher latency and intermittent errors in US-West for generation requests. Our on-call team is working on mitigation; we will update shortly. If you see production impact, reply here with request IDs and region."
ben (sre): root cause candidate: KV cache eviction storm on one node led to repeated cold starts and longer KV loads causing headroom starvation. mitigation attempt: cordon and drain genpool-gw-3 then restart pods on fresh instance type.
alice (oncall): deploy-bot, can we scale up genpool-gw in us-west temporarily? prefer burst capacity rather than immediate rollback.
deploy-bot: Scaling request accepted. +2 replicas to genpool-gw in us-west-2. ETA ~90s. Auto-scaling policy: manual-burst.
ben (sre): started drain on genpool-gw-3. logs indicate heavy malloc failures prior to OOM kill — possibly quantized kernel memory leak. collecting `dmesg` and core logs.
carla (ops): publishing initial note to status page now. posting copy below for quick review:
"Investigating: We are investigating increased latency and intermittent errors for the text generation API in US-West. Mitigation in progress (scaling and pod restarts). No data loss."
alice (oncall): :thumbsup: publish. mark affected components: Generation API - US-West. Severity: partial degradation. ETA for next update: 15 minutes.
carla (ops): published initial update to status page and sent internal ops mailbox. link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1769609999 (internal-only).
eve (support): updated top 3 active customer threads with the blurb and asked for request IDs. asked policy: escalate any customer reporting production errors with >50% request failure rate.
ben (sre): after scale and restarts p95 dropped from 3.2s -> 1.1s for new pods, but legacy pods still experiencing tail latency. working to cordon older flavor and force reschedule to patched image.
alice (oncall): plan: (1) burst scale to absorb traffic, (2) cordon+replace genpool-gw-3/4, (3) if regression persists rollback to previous quantization kernel build. keep comms cadence every 15.
maria (legal): quick check — any PII exposure risk or data retention changes? if customers ask about data handling, we should say no data loss and no retained logs beyond normal retention.
ben (sre): confirmed no unusual data writes; KV cache evictions only. no evidence of secret or customer data leak.
alice (oncall): 15m update: scaling reduced 5xx rate from 1.8% -> 0.4%. still seeing intermittent latency for long-context requests (>2k tokens). status page updated.
carla (ops): posted 15m update: engineers have applied scaling and restarts; error rates reduced but some requests with long context remain degraded. mitigation continues.
eve (support): bumped priority for customers on Dedicated plans and notified TAMs. prepared FAQ snippet: "If you're on Dedicated and experiencing, contact your TAM for immediate assistance."
ben (sre): replaced two problematic hosts; memory pressure cleared. monitoring for recurrence. running a canary workload (long-context profiles) — initial pass looks OK.
alice (oncall): good signal. prepare resolved copy once we confirm 30m stable. carla, legal ack'd the comm language.
carla (ops): ready to publish resolved when you confirm. proposed resolved message:
```
Resolved: The generation API in US-West is restored. We mitigated a node-level memory/kv cache issue by scaling and replacing impacted hosts. Error rates and latency have returned to normal. We will continue monitoring.
```
ben (sre): 30m stable check complete — p95/99 normal, 5xx ~0.05% baseline. no new OOMs. rolling close.
alice (oncall): publishing resolved now. thanks team — please add a short post-incident note to the incident tracker with timeline and root cause (KV eviction -> memory pressure -> restart). assign to ben for RCA draft.
carla (ops): resolved note published to status page and emailed subscribers. closing thread in 1hr after RCA draft starts.
alice (oncall): :white_check_mark: Incident closed (published). follow-up: ben to create RCA, carla to add comms lessons, eve to flag any escalated customer threads for follow-up."
